title: For a surjective closed continuous map the closed sets, opens and locally closed sets are exactly the preimages
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the closed-map companion of the open-map lemma (author lemma at source lines 800-812, label lemma-closed-morphism-quotient-topology): for a surjective closed continuous map, the closure of a subset of the target is the image of the closure of its preimage, and closedness, openness and local closedness are tested on preimages, so the map is submersive. The proof (source lines 814-826) runs the same scheme as the open version but with the sandwich argument in part (1), where the image of the closure of the preimage is trapped between T and its closure (proof lines 815-817), and then derives the remaining parts by complementation and restriction (proof lines 817-825). H2.
